instructions:
1. Sort the three data rows with the shell: :2,4!sort
2. Uppercase the header with the shell: :1!tr a-z A-Z
3. Bump the patch version 1.4.9 to 1.4.10 (put the cursor on 9, then Ctrl-a).
4. Raise retries from 3 to 5 (2 Ctrl-a).
5. Renumber the steps 1, 2, 3: select the test and deploy lines with V, then g Ctrl-a.
